candidates.name: Vascular Tumor of Thyroid origin with metastasis
support_spans: Endoscopic examination found a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities.
Enhanced CT scan showed a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra
Confirmed a hypervascular tumor with anterior skull base extension
Found considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions.
Serum Thyroglobulin': '4432 ng/mL (significantly elevated)
contradict_spans: The sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
candidates.why: The combination of imaging studies, laboratory tests, and biopsy results suggest a vascular thyroid tumor with metastasis to the nasal cavity, ribs, and vertebra.
